title: What a meteorite does when it hits you ☄️
subject: meteorite
description:
Would you keep the rock or sell it? 👇

In 1954 a meteorite crashed through a roof in Sylacauga, Alabama, and hit Ann Hodges on her couch. She is the first known person injured by a meteorite.

Sources: Smithsonian Magazine, "1954 Extraterrestrial Bruiser Shocked Alabama Woman"; National Geographic, "Meteorite That Hit Alabama Woman" (2013, quoting astronomer Michael Reynolds); Astronomy, "Nov. 30, 1954: The first known human injury via a meteorite".
tags: what happens if a meteorite hits you
odds of being hit by a meteorite

scenes.text: A space rock punched through her roof and hit her.
Sylacauga, Alabama, November 30, 1954. Ann Hodges was napping under quilts on her couch.
The 8.5-pound meteorite bounced off her radio console and slammed into her hip.
Outside, people saw a reddish light streak across the sky like a Roman candle.
It left a pineapple-shaped bruise, the first known human injury from a meteorite.
Experts put your odds at about 1 in 1.6 million. Ann Hodges beat them on her own couch.
